starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.player: Hello there, Easter Bunny. Is everything alright?

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: No, no. This can't be happening!

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.player: Take a deep breath, calm down. Tell me what's wrong.

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: I thought for once everything would run as smooth as milk chocolate.

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: I had everything prepared! The eggs, the baskets - I even straightened my ears before I got here.

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.player: Straightened your ears? How would you even-

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: And then disaster struck! I counted my eggs backwards, forwards, upside-down and up, but alas... One is missing.

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.player: Are you sure you brought the right amount?

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: Absolutely! I have an entire year to plan for Easter. What do you think I do when I'm not here celebrating with you?

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.player: Well, I suppose I never thought about that.

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: I'm at home, painting and counting eggs, of course! And tending to my chickens.

starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.speaker: Easter Bunny
starting-the-event-talking-to-the-easter.text: Oh, I can't stomach this. [player name], won't you help me find the missing egg?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Thank you! Archibald left a note before he left. It may help you find him. It's on a table just over there.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: He is a curious one. Whenever he hears of interesting places, he tends to want to go there.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Of course. I name all my eggs. There's also Eggward, Eggon, Leggolas and Greggory, to name a few.

steps.player: And you teach them to write, too?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: --The Easter Bunny winks at you.--

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Go on now, before he travels too far!

steps.player: Guess I'm off to chase an egg.
I don't have time at the moment, sorry.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Oh Archibald, oh Archibald. Wheresoever art thou, Archibald?

starting-the-event-searching-the-note-on.player: I should probably talk to the Easter Bunny before I take anything.

options.text: What are you going to do now?

steps.player: What are you going to do now?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: My eggs and I are going to spread the Easter cheer to the fine city of Varrock.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Many people grow up without chocolate, you know. It's just not right.

steps.player: So true. What has the world come to?

options.text: Why did you decide to celebrate Easter in Varrock?

steps.player: Why did you decide to celebrate Easter in Varrock?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: All of Gielinor deserve to celebrate Easter. I figured Varrock is a particularly busy place.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: By positioning myself here I maximise my CTPOTR.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: CTPOTR. Chocolate to person over time ratio. You need to maximise your reach and minimise time spent, to optimise value.

steps.player: I see. I never realised how seriously you took this.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Of course. Easter only happens once a year. I have to make the most out of it.

options.text: Can you tell me more about the Easter eggs?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about the Easter eggs?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: The eggs are a family tradition. Hatching them, caring for them, watching them develop. This is the job of an Easter Bunny.

steps.player: Hold on. Are you saying there are more Easter bunnies?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Oh yes, my mother was one. And my father. And their parents before them.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Maybe one day you can become one too!

steps.player: I'm more of an adventurer-type person, myself.
